saturnus 0.10.2 makes the Windows command-line tools start on any Windows,
and the desktop app no longer pauses a key press while it saves.

## Get it

- **On the web**, nothing to install: <https://ractive.ch/saturnus/app/>
  (Chrome or Edge for a serial cable; every browser for the emulated
  calculator).
- **The desktop app** `saturnus_0.10.2_…` (on Linux `saturnus-app`), with
  a `-SHA256SUMS` file beside them:
  - macOS, Apple silicon: `.dmg`, signed and notarised, or `brew trust
    --cask ractive/tap/saturnus-app` once, then `brew install --cask
    ractive/tap/saturnus-app`;
  - Windows: `.msi` or `-setup.exe` for x86_64 (`x64`) and ARM (`arm64`);
  - Linux: `.deb`, `.rpm` or `.AppImage` for x86_64 (`amd64`, `x86_64`)
    and ARM (`arm64`, `aarch64`). Add yourself to the `dialout` group to
    use a serial port.
- **The command-line tools** `saturnus` and `satx`: `cargo install`,
  Homebrew `ractive/tap`, Scoop `ractive`, or the archives and Linux
  packages below.
- **Libraries** on crates.io, all at 0.10.2.

## Windows

- **No Visual C++ runtime needed.** `saturnus.exe` and `satx.exe` now
  carry the C runtime inside them. Before, a Windows without the
  Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable could not start them at all; now
  the zip, Scoop and winget versions run as they are.
- **Running `saturnus` or `satx` on its own shows the help.** Without a
  command, both print their short help, the same as `-h`, and end
  without an error. Before, they stopped with a "missing command" error,
  which made automatic install checks such as winget's fail. An unknown
  command or option is still an error.

## Desktop app

- **Saving no longer holds up the calculator.** The app saves the
  calculator's state in the background, so a key pressed while a large
  state (the 49G's) is being written is no longer delayed. Only the
  newest state waits to be saved, and starting up, starting fresh and
  closing the window wait until it is written.
